# WRTV

> WRTV is Indianapolis's ABC 6 affiliate providing comprehensive local news, weather, sports, and entertainment coverage for Central Indiana.

WRTV serves the Indianapolis metropolitan area with breaking news, detailed weather forecasting, Indiana sports coverage including the Colts and WNBA, and community-focused content. The station is part of the Scripps News Group network.

## Key Topics

- Indianapolis
- Indiana
- Local News
- Breaking News
- Weather Forecasts
- Crime & Safety
- Indianapolis Colts
- WNBA
- Marion County
- Community Events
- Employment Opportunities
- National News
- Politics
- Economy
- Sports

## Local News & Community

- [Local News Indianapolis](https://www.wrtv.com/news/local-news): WRTV local news covering Indianapolis, Marion County, and community updates
- [Indianapolis Crime News and Reports](https://www.wrtv.com/news/local-news/crime): Indianapolis crime news, homicides, shootings, and police reports
- [Indianapolis Events and Things to Do](https://www.wrtv.com/entertainment/inside-indy): Indianapolis events, dining, entertainment, and things to do guide
- [Jobs in Indianapolis](https://www.wrtv.com/news/hiring-hoosiers): Indianapolis jobs, employment opportunities, and career resources
- [Central Indiana History](https://www.wrtv.com/lifestyle/history): Central Indiana history, landmarks, and historical preservation stories

## Weather & Forecasts

- [Indianapolis Weather](https://www.wrtv.com/weather): Live Indianapolis weather conditions, forecasts, and radar from WRTV
- [7-Day Forecast](https://www.wrtv.com/weather/daily-forecast): 7-day weather forecast and alerts for Indianapolis from WRTV
- [Hourly Weather Forecast](https://www.wrtv.com/weather/hourly-forecast): Hourly weather forecast for Indianapolis with three-day outlook
- [Weather Blogs](https://www.wrtv.com/weather/weather-blogs): Weather blogs from WRTV meteorologists covering Central Indiana forecasts

## Sports

- [Indiana Sports News & Scores](https://www.wrtv.com/sports): Indiana sports coverage including Colts, WNBA, and local high school sports

- [National News](https://www.wrtv.com/news/national-news): National news and headlines from across the United States
